tts.speedHint: Default 170 words per minute. Lower speeds support foundational listening practice; higher speeds support advanced practice. The paper structure and 13-second answer pauses do not change.
tts.aliyunHint: Jennifer + Neil are recommended. This API key is stored separately and never reuses the DeepSeek key.
tts.mimoHint: Recommended preset voices are Chloe (female) and Milo (male); the model is currently free for a limited time. The voicedesign and voiceclone variants require a text voice description or reference audio, so they are not yet enabled for unattended full-paper generation. This endpoint uses a separate API key, and pricing may change.
tts.siliconflowHint: CosyVoice2-0.5B and MOSS-TTSD currently cost about ¥0.05 per 1,000 characters. The model and voice IDs remain editable.
tts.kittenHint: Kitten Nano runs locally with no network or API key. Rosie + Bruno are currently the closest published match to the reference exam voices.
tts.localHint: Connect an OpenAI-compatible local or self-hosted endpoint such as Qwen3-TTS, Kokoro, GPT-SoVITS, or another provider wrapper. WAV responses are the most reliable.
tts.apiKeyHint: Alibaba Cloud, Xiaomi MiMo, or SiliconFlow key; optional for a custom endpoint
tts.connectionFailed: Speech connection failed. Check the key, endpoint, and model.

providerDescription.deepseek: Uses the current DeepSeek model API key with the official Search / Fetch API; no separate search key is required.
providerDescription.tavily: Real-time web search and extraction designed for AI/RAG workflows.
providerDescription.exa: Semantic search with summaries and web content extraction.
providerDescription.firecrawl: Web search with optional Markdown scraping for deep reading.

webSearch.deepseekHintTitle: DeepSeek now supports official web search and page fetch
webSearch.deepseekHint: The DeepSeek provider reuses the active model API key. Summary mode returns search results only; deep read requests page content. Search and fetch are billed separately under DeepSeek's official pricing.
webSearch.deepseekFetchNote: Official endpoints: POST /v1/tools/search and /v1/tools/fetch. Fetched content may be limited by a target site's access policy.
